name: Han Ji-eun
bio: Han Ji-eun is a South Korean actress. In 2005, she graduated from Dongduk Women's University, and made her acting debut in the 2010 movie “Be With Me”.

credits.title: The Intern
credits.overview: Ki-ho, a retiree with 37 years of experience, joins fashion start-up WOO22 a senior intern, he struggles with its digital, unconventional culture. Despite their differences, Ki-ho and Sun-woo, the start-up's young CEO, learn from each other and form an unexpected bond.

credits.overview: Do-woon, orphaned and raised by a priest, is ordained as a priest. In the confessional, he hears that his mother was murdered and an evil group reveals itself.

credits.title: The Stranger
credits.overview: A drama that tells the story of COVID-19 confirmed patients in 2020 who enter a residential treatment center, communicating through windows and comforting each other during unfamiliar and fearful quarantine times.

credits.title: EP, Hi Dorothy
credits.overview: A psychological follow-up drama between a "stigma-making" Internet reporter and a "stigma-erasing" digital undertaker, over a horrific incident caused by a hidden camera crime.

credits.title: Scent of a Ghost
credits.overview: Ji Yeon is a beautiful university student, majoring in music. She is dating Dong Seok, but Dong Seok’s parents want him to study abroad. The day before he is scheduled to leave South Korea to study abroad, he prepares a proposal event for Ji Yeon. Ji Yeon does not appear at the event.

credits.title: Door Lock
credits.overview: Kyung-min lives alone in a one-room apartment. One day, she finds traces of a stranger breaking into her room and soon a mysterious murder case begins to unravel.

credits.title: Real
credits.overview: A criminal aspiring to build a casino finds himself in endless threat when a doppelgänger appears, who starts imitating every single thing he does.

credits.title: The Tooth and the Nail
credits.overview: Seok-jin, a magician at a club, meets a mysterious woman, Ha-yeon, who soon becomes his assistant and fiance. Things take a turn when she is found dead and he must find out what happened.

credits.overview: In real life, Kwon Yoo is unemployed, but in the virtual game world he is the best leader. Kwon Yoo is then framed for a murder. With the help of hacker Yeo-wool, he tries to uncover the truth behind the murder case.

credits.overview: When a zombie virus pushes Korea into a state of emergency, those trapped on an express train to Busan must fight for their own survival.

credits.overview: Jung-hoon and Si-hoo, both fresh from breakups, make a pact to have nine casual flings. As their encounters continue, their connection intensifies, blurring the lines between friendship and love.

credits.overview: A wily safecracker is forced to help a mob boss pull off a $150 million heist, but smells a double-cross in the works.

credits.overview: Lee Gong-jin, a young tailor, helps the Queen with her dress and both fall in love with each other. However, his success catches the ire of Jo Dol-seok, the royal tailor, who vows retribution.

credits.title: Miss Granny
credits.overview: An unappreciated old granny magically turns 20 years old again and decides to make the most of her newfound youth.
